''See also: [[Vasha Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Vasha is a [[Dragon's Fang]], an artifact of [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] that was seized from a fallen enemy and integrated into [[Valinhall]]. Measuring approximately five feet from the pommel to the tip, the weapon is shorter than other Fangs such as [[Mithra]] or Azura. Unlike those more elongated blades, Vasha possesses a practical length and features a dull, pitted surface with a chipped blade, appearing as though it has been struck against stone. Despite this worn appearance, the [[steel]] is now indestructible and resistant to scuffing. The sword can be summoned to a user's hand and possesses its own personality, which a wielder can sense more deeply through direct connection. In combat, the blade is capable of slicing through bone and ordinary [[steel]] with ease, deflecting elemental attacks like fire, and delivering strikes with the force of a hammer. However, it can be lost or rendered unreachable if cast away.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Vasha first flashed against [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]]'s bar of dark ice before being summoned by [[Indirial]]. As a weapon that shimmers like an illusion, it features phantom [[chains]] that crawl across the user's flesh and possesses a cracked blade. After falling from the numb hands of [[Zakareth]], the blade was used by [[Indirial]] to bite through ordinary [[steel]]. Although Vasha was briefly missing from the [[entry hall]] while being counted among [[Indirial]]'s six subjects, it eventually returned to his side. The weapon was ultimately utilized in combat against [[Kai]].}}
